connector.name: Rackspace Spot
connector.registryDescription: Manage Rackspace Spot Kubernetes Cloudspaces, node pools, and VMs from your AI assistant.
connector.summary: Hosted at mcp.spot.rackspace.com over streamable HTTP, also runs locally from the container image spot-mcp:latest. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches all 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the rackspace-spot account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: SPOT_REFRESH_TOKEN
env.description: Rackspace Spot API refresh token used to authenticate.

env.name: SPOT_ORG
env.description: Default Rackspace Spot organization namespace; can be overridden per tool call.
